cases.given: The handoff needs the basis and open issues, not a transcript of private reasoning.
cases.expect: The next analyst can resume and audit the decision basis.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a one-turn answer has no meaningful state
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Canonical cited evidence overrides stale state summaries.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Stop treating the block as authoritative if provenance is missing or fields are stale.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A model has evidence, an assumption, and a tentative conclusion before handoff.
cases.expect: Expose each in a separately labeled, provenance-aware state record with a next step.
cases.reject: Return a free-form chain-of-thought transcript or merge the assumption into the facts.
